intended_delta: Disconnect U17-PWR2 FAULT1# from GND and attach a LED_FAULT_L_N stub matching FAULT2#. Exposed pad stays on GND. No other wires.
observed_delta: Block-scale capture of U17-PWR2 (TPS2561, 2536x1091) after Captain Fit Selection. FAULT1# pin 10 carries a short dedicated stub labelled LED_FAULT_L_N. Pin 1 and the exposed pad remain on GND. The FAULT name is not on the GND bus. IN pins stay on 5V_SYS; OUT1/OUT2 stay on 5V_LED_L_SW / 5V_LED_R_SW.

checks.name: FAULT1# pin 10 no longer joins GND wire e82471
checks.detail: Pin 10 FAULT1# shows a short stub that ends at a net-port marker and is labelled LED_FAULT_L_N. It does not continue into the GND island on pin 1 or the exposed pad.

checks.name: LED_FAULT_L_N is not a net name on the GND bus
checks.detail: The GND labels sit on pin 1 and on the exposed-pad pin 11 only. LED_FAULT_L_N appears only on the FAULT1# stub.

checks.name: a dedicated LED_FAULT_L_N stub sits on FAULT1# like FAULT2#
checks.detail: FAULT1# has the same short rightward stub-and-label pattern used for the other fault pin, with LED_FAULT_L_N as its own net name.

checks.name: U17 exposed pad pin 11 remains on GND
checks.detail: The exposed-pad pin on the right of U17 is still wired into the GND net, separate from the FAULT1# stub.
